messages:
jonah: Heads-up — EU mini-canary for v2-14 (q8 kernels) is showing a p95 jump on short sequences. Baseline p95 ~170ms, canary ~220ms (+28%). Small-seq tail only, throughput looks stable. Anyone oncall who can triage?
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: v2-14-eu-mini at 07:02 UTC. 50 hosts, routing 5%. Logs: no deploy errors.
maya: Ack. Which benchmark did you run? can you paste the query that produced the numbers?
jonah: Ran the scheduled smoke bench (short-window). Command I used: `bench/regression --model v2-14 --seq 32 --quant q8 --runs 200 --tag eu-mini`. I can paste the raw CSV if useful.
priya: If it's small seq specific, could be kernel selection change or KV cache thrash. Can we run a kernel-bisect (fast) and also a perf flame (sample) on one impacted host?
liam: I did a quick local repro on a dev box with the same build. Saw increased L2 miss rates and a few +syscall ticks during kv cache refill. Not a full repro but hints at cache behavior.
suneel: Oncall here. Recommend holding rollout and toggling traffic down to 1% while we triage. If confirmed, we should fallback to the fp16 variant or previous model.
aria: I can flip traffic to 1% now. Prefetching rollback artifacts prepared (v2-13 pinned snapshot). Do we want a soft fallback (route 10% to v2-14-fp16) or full rollback to v2-13 in EU?
maya: Let's collect a quick kernel-bisect on one canary host and run `bench/regression --seq 32 --runs 500 --trace-perf` to get a sampling profile. If bisect points to q8 kernel, fallback to fp16 is cheaper, but if it's config-level then rollback.
jonah: Sounds good. Action plan: 1) aria reduce traffic to 1% now 2) liam run kernel-bisect on one host and attach perf lines 3) maya run extended bench with --trace-perf 4) priy a watch for infra anomalies (mem, page fault) 5) suneel prepare rollback to v2-13 EU.
aria: Reduced to 1% (done). Canary control-plane shows healthy.
liam: Starting bisect now — will post summary. Quick note: repro is flaky locally, might need to run multiple iterations.
priya: Also check autoscaler logs — if any hosts spun up with different kernel flags. Could be a deploy config drift.
maya: If bisect points to kernel Q8, we can try runtime override to use fp16 kernels for small seq in EU for a quick mitigation (no infra roll required). Otherwise roll back.
jonah: Vote call: +1 rollback to v2-13 EU if bisect implicates non-fixable kernel drift. +1 mitigate with fp16 override if it's purely quant kernel. Anyone object?
suneel: +1 rollback readiness. I'll prep the change and run the rollback playbook if we confirm.
liam: bisect round 1: Q8_conv_v2.3 shows increased cycles on GEMM path. Attaching snippet in thread (will paste shortly).
jonah: Given early bisect pointing at q8 kernel, let's aim for fp16 fallback first (low blast radius). Aria — can you stage an fp16 routing rule at 10%? If that reduces p95 we hold; else rollback.
aria: Staging fp16 route at 10% for EU now.
maya: After fp16 routing: p95 on sampled traces dropped back to ~175ms. Looks promising but need 30m sampling to be confident.
priya: Monitoring infra — no additional faults.
suneel: If fp16 holds after 30m, we can keep fp16 as a temporary mitigation and create an RCA + kernel regression ticket. If it drifts back, execute rollback to v2-13.
jonah: Agreed. For now: HOLD rollout, 10% fp16 fallback, collect 30m of traces, open ticket: ENG-???? (perf regression, v2-14 q8). I'll start the ticket and link this thread.
aria: Done: traffic staged, metrics dashboards updated, and alerting set for p95 > +15% over baseline.
liam: Will follow up with perf snippets and sample profiles in the ticket.
maya: Thanks team. Good catch.
jonah: Closing the decision for now: hold + fp16 mitigation. We reconvene if indicators cross threshold or after 30m. Thanks all.
